entries.076bc8520c06e720: Collection and transport of household general waste (hired-vehicle contracts)
entries.1e718c88163a5899: This business receives entrustment from Tokyo's 23 special wards administrative bodies to recycle non-combustible waste, container and packaging waste, and metal bulky waste at the company's recycling centers. Consolidated subsidiary Yodosei Co., Ltd. transports general waste discharged from households to government treatment facilities and disposal sites under hired-vehicle contracts with Tokyo's 23 special wards. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,381 million.
entries.3dc630f5eff180aa: This business sorts, crushes, compresses and packs waste paper, bottles, cans, PET bottles, bulky waste and other materials brought to recycling centers, converting them into recycled resources, and sells the recycled products and valuable materials to businesses. Cardboard and some confidential documents are collected by dedicated vehicles and sold to waste paper dealers or delivered directly to paper mills. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,339 million.
entries.416885969271c31d: This business collects, transports and disposes mainly industrial waste and business-related general waste from business establishments, mainly in Tokyo's 23 special wards. The company holds collection and transport permits for almost all types of waste routinely discharged from business establishments, including bottles, cans, PET bottles, bulky waste, combustible waste, cardboard and waste paper, and has regular collection contracts with more than 8,200 collection sites. As of March 31, 2026, the group owned 477 vehicles and had approximately 420 drivers. Collected waste is processed at the company's eight recycling centers in Tokyo's 23 special wards and at government incineration plants, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,227 million.
entries.4b3ed18bfc271436: A company that collects, transports, and disposes of waste from offices and households, and recycles resource materials, mainly in Tokyo's 23 wards.

entries.b5537439897eb5ce: This is a single-segment business centered on Tokyo's 23 special wards, providing collection, transport and disposal of industrial and general waste, and recycling of recyclable materials. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,949 million, broken down into ¥10,227 million from the Collection, Transport and Disposal Business, ¥3,381 million from the Public Entrustment Business and ¥1,339 million from the Recycling Business.
